speckit.analyze.description: Perform a non-destructive cross-artifact consistency and quality analysis across spec.md, plan.md, and tasks.md after task generation.

speckit.checklist.description: Generate a custom checklist for the current feature based on user requirements.

speckit.clarify.description: Identify underspecified areas in the current feature spec by asking up to 5 highly targeted clarification questions and encoding answers back into the spec. (Phase 1: Spec)

speckit.commit.description: Review changes, generate a commit message, push to remote, and create a pull request.

speckit.constitution.description: Create or update the project constitution from interactive or provided principle inputs, ensuring all dependent templates stay in sync.

handoffs.label: Build Specification
handoffs.prompt: Implement the feature specification based on the updated constitution. I want to build...

speckit.implement.description: Execute the implementation plan by processing and executing all tasks defined in tasks.md

speckit.jira.description: Pull JIRA tickets via MCP and auto-generate specs/<KEY>/jira.json and spec.md for each feature. (Phase 1: Spec)

speckit.plan.description: Generate the technical plan and tasks from a reviewed spec. (Phase 2: Plan)

handoffs.label: Analyze For Consistency
handoffs.prompt: Run a project analysis for consistency

handoffs.label: Create Checklist
handoffs.prompt: Create a checklist for the following domain...

speckit.specify.description: Create or update the feature specification from a natural language feature description. (Phase 1: Spec)

speckit.tasks.description: Generate an actionable, dependency-ordered tasks.md for the feature based on available design artifacts.

handoffs.label: Analyze For Consistency
handoffs.prompt: Run a project analysis for consistency

speckit.taskstoissues.description: Convert existing tasks into actionable, dependency-ordered GitHub issues for the feature based on available design artifacts.
